title: 3 Interstellar Visitors Turned A Fluke Into A Pattern
hook: The third interstellar visitor proved the first was not alone.
closing: Repeated visitors let scientists compare material from other stars instead of guessing from one.
question: Will we ever catch one?

segments.say: Only 3 interstellar visitors are confirmed, turning a supposed fluke into a repeat pattern.
The newest interstellar visitor hit 246,000 kilometers per hour, making each confirmed arrival faster than the last.
The newest interstellar visitor spans 5.6 kilometers, nearly six times the previous record holder and offering more material to study.
